evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: "Own and evolve", "drive cross-functional initiatives", "develop the AI stack" suggest proactive, fast-moving expectations. However, "attention to detail", "well-documented", "governed and discoverable" signal rigour is equally valued. Balanced but leans velocity.
evidence.domain_risk: Getsafe is an insurance company — data errors can affect regulatory reporting, claims calculations, and premium pricing, all of which carry financial and legal liability. "AI-ready data foundations" with "governed" as a criterion and "attention to detail and ownership mindset" named explicitly are signals of a risk-conscious environment.
evidence.jd_authorship: "AI-ready data foundations: structured, governed, and discoverable data models", "Develop the data and analytics components of the AI stack to support experimentation and GenAI applications", "modern transformation frameworks, especially dbt", "Own and evolve core business metrics — from definition to tracking and operationalisation" — precise, opinionated phrases authored by an engineer, not recruiter filler.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: "Develop the AI stack", "own and evolve core business metrics from definition", "design clean, reliable data models as a single source of truth" are establish/build signals. Mixed but leans greenfield; "maintain scalable data pipelines" suggests some existing infrastructure to steward.
evidence.data_team_maturity: "Own and evolve core business metrics — from definition to tracking" (implies metrics are not yet fully defined), "develop the data and analytics components of the AI stack" (AI stack is being built, not maintained). "2+ years" experience requirement suggests a smaller team willing to develop talent — likely 2–4 people covering a wide surface.
evidence.collaboration_width: "Drive cross-functional data initiatives with stakeholders across Commercial, Operations, and Engineering." Three distinct internal functions named verbatim; Data Scientists using the AI stack are an implicit fourth audience.
evidence.urgency: No explicit urgency language, but "own and evolve core business metrics" and "develop the AI stack" as the top two responsibilities suggest the company is at a critical inflection — scaling AI applications while lacking a reliable metric layer.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Own and evolve core business metrics - from definition to tracking and operationalisation; Develop the data and analytics components of the AI stack to support experimentation and GenAI applications
evidence.autonomy_level: Own and evolve core business metrics - from definition to tracking and operationalisation
